rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when something is expressive of emotion or feeling.

example.english: They gave a very lyrical account of that memory.
example.traditional: 佢講嗰段回憶講得好有感情。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 go2 dyun6 wui4 jik1 gong2 dak1 hou2 jau5 gam2 cing4

rows.note: Use this attributive construction when “lyrical” means relating to lyrics, as in 歌詞內容.

example.english: I quite like the lyrical content of this song.
example.traditional: 我幾鍾意呢首歌歌詞嘅內容。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gei2 zung1 ji3 ne1 sau2 go1 go1 ci4 ge3 noi6 jung4

rows.note: Use this when “lyrical” emphasizes that a melody is readily singable rather than emotionally expressive.

example.english: This song has a simple, lyrical melody that's easy to sing.
example.traditional: 呢首歌旋律簡單，幾易唱。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 go1 syun4 leot2 gaan2 daan1 gei2 ji6 coeng3
